items.prompt: Replacing the worst observed loss with a hypothetical larger loss yields what?

options.text: A sensitivity/stress scenario, not a confidence interval
options.why: Its role and assumed changes must be labeled.

options.text: The exact probability of a future crash
options.why: A hypothetical value has no supplied probability model.

options.text: Proof that all models have become correct
options.why: A scenario does not validate source data or a stochastic model.

options.text: An automatic authorization to alter the portfolio
options.why: A learning calculation grants no trading authority.

items.explanation: Stress responses show consequences of assumptions; inferential probability claims need a justified model and procedure.
